title: To predict or to persist: how decoherence shapes learning in a spin-qubit quantum reservoir
abstract: arXiv:2611.26215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work we investigate how dephasing and the choice of measured observables affect learning in a simulated six-qubit spin chain with Markovian dissipation and exact expectation-value readout. For externally driven nonlinear autoregressive moving-average signals, combining single- and two-qubit observables gives better predictions than a population-only readout at comparable polynomial feature counts. Most of the configurations we tested become more accurate than a reference with relaxation and dephasing disabled, most strongly at $T_2=1\,\mu$s, where total memory capacity drops, and still at $T_2=5$-$10\,\mu$s, where memory is only redistributed across delays. For autonomous generation, we train the readout with scheduled sampling and iterative dataset aggregation to expose it to states reached under its own feedback. We do not find a clear systematic dependence of limit-cycle persistence on coherence across the reservoir ensemble

translated_title: 预测还是持续：退相干如何塑造自旋量子比特量子库中的学习
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们研究了相位退相干以及测量可观测量（观测对象）的选择如何影响一个具有马尔可夫耗散和精确期望值读出的模拟六量子比特自旋链中的学习。对于外部驱动的非线性自回归滑动平均（NARMA）信号，在相当的多项式特征数量下，结合单量子比特与双量子比特可观测量进行读出，比仅使用布居数读出能获得更好的预测效果。我们测试的大多数配置都比禁用弛豫与退相干的参考系统更加准确，其中在 T₂=1 微秒时效果最为显著，此时总记忆容量下降；而在 T₂=5-10 微秒时依然如此，此时记忆只是在各个延迟之间重新分布。对于自主生成任务，我们采用计划采样和迭代数据集聚合的方法训练读出层，使其接触到自身反馈下所到达的量子态。我们没有发现极限环的持续性对储层集合的相干时间存在清晰的系统性依赖。
tldr: 该研究发现适度的退相干（如 T₂=1 微秒时）反而能提升量子库计算对 NARMA 信号的预测准确度，且混合单/双量子比特观测量读出优于纯布居数读出，而自主生成中极限环的持续性与相干时间并无明显的系统性关联。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that moderate decoherence (e.g., T2=1 μs) can actually enhance prediction accuracy of a spin-qubit quantum reservoir on NARMA signals, with mixed single- and two-qubit observable readouts outperforming population-only readout, while limit-cycle persistence in autonomous generation shows no clear systematic dependence on coherence.
